outcome: pregnancy-related complications (preeclampsia, pregnancy-induced hypertension, sickle cell crisis, eclampsia)
cohort: The study included 40 pregnant women with sickle cell disease whose antenatal records were reviewed at the University of Calabar Teaching Hospital.
finding: The study found no significant association between blood transfusions and pregnancy-related complications, maternal mortality, type of birth, stillbirths, or spontaneous abortions in pregnant women with sickle cell disease.
mod_finding: There was no association between blood transfusions and the type of birth.
